# SDK API Requirements Checklist: Reusable SDK Applier

**Purpose**: Review the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the Applier API and lifecycle requirements before task generation and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Focus**: Public SDK/resource contracts and lifecycle resilience, including the optional secret-file helper.
**Depth**: Standard
**Audience / Timing**: Reviewer; design review before task generation, reusable during PR review.

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK031 Are confidentiality boundaries explicitly documented for source diagnostics, result representations, inspection data, decryption output, and chained errors? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-014, Spec §FR-019, Data Model §Results and errors, Contract: SOPS §Errors and confidential diagnostics]

  **Review resolution**: The user clarified that decrypted values injected into ManifestSource have no special protection. They are ordinary input data; Applier representations, validation/platform errors, and traceback chains do not require secret-specific redaction. Confidentiality guarantees remain limited to the SOPS helper’s own plaintext handling and diagnostics. See [the user clarification](../spec.md#clarifications), [FR-004 and FR-019](../spec.md#functional-requirements), [general data handling](../contracts/applier-api.md#methods), and [helper diagnostics](../contracts/sops-helper.md#errors-and-confidential-diagnostics). This explicit boundary satisfies CHK031 and supersedes the earlier request for broader diagnostic protection.

- [x] CHK032 Are caller-resource immutability, model field/alias compatibility, and omitted-versus-explicit value semantics specified for inherited and overridden resource behavior? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, Spec §Explicit User and Project Constraints, Data Model §Existing models and compatibility]
- [x] CHK033 Are async responsiveness and cleanup guarantees bounded to platform waits and subprocess work, with synchronous preparation limitations and transport configuration ownership documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-019, Plan §Scale/Scope, Contract: Applier §Imports and construction]
- [x] CHK034 Are public typing, documented failure behavior, module separation, Python compatibility, and repository quality obligations stated consistently with the constitution? [Consistency, Spec §Explicit User and Project Constraints, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Evaluation — 2026-10-09

**Result**: 40 of 40 criteria satisfied following the user’s clarification of CHK031. This is a requirements-quality review, not an implementation certification. The requested specification path is interpreted as `specs/001-sdk-applier/spec.md`. The specification is the primary source; the plan, data model, contracts, quickstart, and constitution supply the supporting context explicitly named by the checklist. Supporting design details satisfy criteria where the specification delegates those details; they are not all required to be duplicated in `spec.md`.

CHK040 is satisfied after this evaluation refreshes the stale unevaluated-state note and distinguishes the historical absence of tasks from the current artifacts. Current FR-001–FR-019 and SC-001–SC-008, the optional helper, call-time clients, and later planning clarifications are consistent in the reviewed requirements artifacts. The initial evaluation changed only this API checklist. The subsequent user clarification was recorded in the specification and reconciled across the plan, data model, contracts, research, quickstart, existing task descriptions, and built-in checklist notes. Task and built-in checklist checkbox states remain unchanged.
